architectureHighlights.title: Sandboxed gRPC Gateway
architectureHighlights.description: TLS-enabled WebSocket/JSON-RPC front door with auth, rate limiting, and ACL enforcement before any query reaches the database.

architectureHighlights.title: Query Executor
architectureHighlights.description: Builds safe, parameterized SQL statements, validates ACL rules, and routes requests through the configured adapters.

architectureHighlights.title: Adapter Layer
architectureHighlights.description: Pluggable backends (Postgres/MySQL/SQLite) with typed capability metadata so the core client stays agnostic to the engine.

securityFeatures: Process isolation, capability enforcement, and a least-privilege sandbox per deployment.
Credential vault referenced by the daemon only — secrets never leave the server process.
Audit logging for every RPC call, including user, operation, entity, and success/failure.
Row-level security + per-operation ACL checks keep queries scoped to the requester.
